raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (378 rows, source_tz='UTC') stores txn_ts in UTC, while every other batch stores Chicago local time (about 06:00 local). The pipeline ignores source_tz, so the 99 UTC rows from 00:00-06:00 on 2026-01-19 are assigned to the wrong business date and sit outside opening hours. Converting UTC-tagged timestamps to America/Chicago before deriving txn_date should move them to 2026-01-18 local.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH src AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN ((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM src;"}}
